text:
Maya Li: quick one  staging DAST picked up an outbound SSRF-like open endpoint on the internal admin proxy. SAST flagged a hardcoded cert path in `gen/proxy/cert.go` that looks like it was emitted during gen with a CI secret present.
Evan Park: can you paste the SAST snippet + scan id?
Maya Li: scan id `DAST-9801` and `SAST-2208`. snippet: `const defaultCert = "/tmp/dev-certs/signing.pem"` but CI artifact shows an actual PEM block in the generated file.
scanbot: run#9801  DAST high (open-external), SAST high (embedded-cert). fingerprints: dast:sha1:3f2b, sast:sha256:ff12. collector=staging-scan.
Nikhil Rao: likely flow: CI uses an ephemeral deploy identity to fetch private certs, generator ran with that env and wrote literal. We must not widen scanner RBAC. Options: reorder CI (scan before fetch), create a read-only fetch role w/o KMS:Decrypt, or suppression with strict audit evidence.
security-bot: policy: suppression requires PR with raw scan JSON, repro script, fingerprint, two approvers (security + owner), and KMS/Vault decrypt audit logs for the CI run. Suppressions >72h escalate.
Evan Park: infra action: add `ci.run_id` and `repo` to KMS decrypt attributes, plus include `ci.step` for the runner step. That will let security query decrypts.
ci-agent: filed infra/PR#991  attach `ci.run_id` to decrypt calls and propose role `ci:artifact-fetcher` with S3:GetObject but no KMS:Decrypt.
Maya Li: short-term plan I propose: 1) open suppression PR scoped to `gen/**` with 72h expiry and full evidence, 2) patch CI to run a canary reordered workflow (scan-before-fetch) in parallel, 3) land infra/PR for metadata and role.
Nikhil Rao: suppress only if evidence proves artifact injection. Attach raw artifact binary, diff, and repro steps. Use fingerprint `sha256:ff12`.
security-bot: suppression template: `/suppress rule=embedded-secret scope=gen/** fingerprint=sha256:ff12 expires=2025-07-04 reason="CI-injected cert; generator emitted artifact" evidence=https://ci.redwood/builds/9801/raw-scan.json`
Evan Park: note: keep suppression duration minimal. If generator fix will take >1 sprint, escalate to policy board for extended exception. Also add an automated test in gen pipeline that fails if outputs contain PEM headers.
Maya Li: created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/889 - includes raw scan JSON, `repro.sh`, and binary artifact.
ci-agent: canary workflow job `scan-before-fetch` queued. Will run in parallel for 24h and report deltas.
Nikhil Rao: generator task created: gen/issue#1450 to remove any behavior that writes env or fetched secrets into files.
security-bot: action items recorded: infra/PR#991, platform/PR#889 (suppression draft), gen/issue#1450. Security will run one-off query after suppression merges: `SELECT * FROM kms_audit WHERE attrs.ci_run_id='1755555555' AND attrs.repo='platform'` to validate decrypts.
Maya Li: thanks all. I'll ping once the canary finishes and when security closes the suppression.
Evan Park: ack.
Nikhil Rao: closing loop tomorrow after audit verification. :lock:
